players.product: Power-first greenfield AI data-center campuses on 15-year triple-net leases (River Bend LA for Anthropic; Beacon Point TX) - ex-Bitcoin-mining platform (American Bitcoin affiliate)

quarterly_data.signal: Beacon Point project described in the 8-K: a turnkey data center of six data halls with a combined 352 MW of critical IT capacity plus an on-site substation, to be built on an approximately 521-acre property in Nueces County, Texas, and leased under a Data Center Lease Agreement to a tenant that is a high-investment-grade company (rated AA- or higher); the tenant is not named.
quarterly_data.figure: 352 MW critical IT capacity; six data halls; ~521-acre site in Nueces County, Texas
